fixed_snapshot_monitor.note: Only explicit refresh connector configuration can request a fresh snapshot; no live connector was configured or benchmarked.

limitations: No natural business drift event gold labels exist; red/white is a cross-sectional group comparison, not a detection-rate benchmark.
False alarms are observed flags on predeclared stratified controls, not a calibrated population significance level.
Synthetic detection metrics describe the listed injected shifts only; distribution change does not establish quality or model-performance loss.
Synthetic delay is counted in observation windows, not real time.
Wall-clock durations include local HTTP handler, object I/O and MySQL operations and are not a production SLA.
